purpose: Development validation, not automatic model activation
curation: Experimental function anchors; ambiguous homologs unlabelled. Broad family hits are not ground truth for a metal/transport direction.
grouping: Connected sequence clusters at >=80% identity and >=80% bilateral coverage, union with genus groups for background controls; exact aliases collapsed. Record source seed overlap separately.
alignment: MAFFT --auto, rebuilt using training members only in every fold
phylogeny: MAFFT, remove columns with >=50% gaps for exploratory trees only, IQ-TREE LG+G4, SH-aLRT 1000, UFBoot 1000, seed 17, max 2 threads
cutoff: Full-sequence HMMER score, MCC optimization using inner out-of-fold predictions, evalue <=1e-5; ties prefer fewer FP then lower cutoff

nested_pilot.warning: Only three experimental positive lineages for MntX; exploratory stability test, not a population accuracy estimate

final_test: No independent external positive set currently available for MntX. Do not invent it from inferred homologs. Promotion is blocked while this limitation remains.
competition: Evaluate raw-score and score-above-cutoff assignments for multi-class development libraries; preselected output uses margin, runtime Efesto is unchanged
uncertainty: Group bootstrap 500 resamples; report valid resamples, small-group limitation and confusion counts
fragments: 25%, 50%, 75% N-terminal, central, C-terminal segments; diagnostic coverage response only, not independent validation
promotion: Always manual. Require adequate label provenance, homologous confounders, external validation and context review; a functionally unsupported clade remains unclassified.
non_changes: No commit/push, no automatic modification to shipped profiles or thresholds. Official profile baseline is retained unless replacement gain is demonstrated.
